notes: Opening a site or device in the MagicBoard now works reliably, straight from the chat: just say "open <site or device>".
Web pages open inside Wingman's own MagicBoard, not an external browser, so Wingman keeps control of the session.
Open a saved network device and Wingman loads its web GUI and signs you in from your vault.
Open a website with a saved login and Wingman asks first before using it; with no saved login it opens the page for you to sign in.
